title: write your VAE training loop

atoms.evidence: kl_div_loss = (0.5 * (mu**2 + t.exp(2 * logsigma) - 1) - logsigma).mean() * self.args.beta_kl — exact analytic KL between N(mu, sigma^2) and N(0,1)
reconstruction_loss = nn.MSELoss()(img, img_reconstructed); kl_div_loss = (...).mean() * self.args.beta_kl; loss = reconstruction_loss + kl_div_loss — recon + beta-weighted KL
@t.inference_mode() log_samples(self): output = self.model(HOLDOUT_DATA)[0]; wandb.log({'images': [wandb.Image(arr) for arr in output.cpu().numpy()]}, step=self.step)
HOLDOUT_DATA tensor built at top of notebook (one image per MNIST class) used in log_samples
@dataclass class VAEArgs(AutoencoderArgs): wandb_project='day5-vae-mnist'; beta_kl: float = 0.1 — subclasses AutoencoderArgs to add beta_kl
if self.args.use_wandb: wandb.finish() at end of train()
reconstruction_loss.item(), kl_div_loss.item(), loss.item() in wandb.log dict
